description: This Java source file defines the SSLUtil class, which provides utility methods for setting up SSL/TLS connections, handling trust managers, key managers, SSL context initialization, and hostname verification configurations within the Apache OFBiz framework.

classes.name: SSLUtil
classes.description: Utility class for SSL context setup, trust management, key management, and hostname verification.

classes.name: TrustAnyManager
classes.description: Implement a trust manager that trusts all certificates, commonly used for testing or non-strict SSL verification.

methods.name: getHostCertNoCheck
methods.description: Returns the constant indicating no certificate verification check.

methods.name: getHostCertMinCheck
methods.description: Returns the constant indicating minimal certificate check.

methods.name: getHostCertNormalCheck
methods.description: Returns the constant indicating normal certificate check.

methods.name: isClientTrusted
methods.description: Checks whether a given certificate chain is trusted based on the configured trust managers.

methods.name: getKeyManagers
methods.description: Returns an array of KeyManagers for the given keystore, optionally using a specified alias.

methods.name: getTrustManagers
methods.description: Returns an array of TrustManagers, aggregating trust stores from configuration and the system trust store.

methods.name: getTrustAnyManagers
methods.description: Returns a TrustManager that trusts all certificates.

methods.name: getSSLContext
methods.description: Creates an SSLContext initialized with specific key and trust managers.

methods.name: getSSLSocketFactory
methods.description: Creates an SSLSocketFactory based on keystore, password, and alias.

methods.name: getSSLServerSocketFactory
methods.description: Creates an SSLServerSocketFactory with specific keystore details.

methods.name: getHostnameVerifier
methods.description: Returns a HostnameVerifier configured based on the specified level of checking.

methods.name: loadJsseProperties
methods.description: Loads Java SSL properties from configuration and sets system properties accordingly.
